newsitem.title: INDIA: India prime minister to expand cabinet on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: India prime minister to expand cabinet on Thursday.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda is scheduled to expand his council of ministers on Thursday, a spokesman of the presidential palace said on Wednesday.
The spokesman said President Shankar Dayal Sharma will administer the oath of office to an unspecified number of new ministers at 4 p.m. (1030 GMT) at a ceremony in the palace.
He said no other details were available.

The United News of India said G.G. Swell, an independent lawmaker from India's northeastern region, and Saifuddin Soz, a member of the National Conference party of the state of Jammu and Kashmir, were among those likely to be included into the cabinet.
